title: Live fraud gate
description: 60 card transactions arrive one at a time, each needing a decision before the next lands — latency, not a batch average, is the headline number. The correct verdict is computed from each transaction's own amount, merchant history, location and hour, not hand-labelled. What we measured: a real model here catches essentially all the actual fraud, but hedges on ordinary transactions rather than confidently clearing them — shown as two separate numbers, not one accuracy figure that would hide which kind of mistake is which.
